_comment: SCA remediation registry. Keys are SCA policy_ids (e.g. cis_centos8_linux). Inner keys are SCA check ids as strings. Each entry maps to a fix action: trmm_script (run a script), use_case (deploy a manifest), or file_delivery (push a templated file). Operators populate this file as they validate fixes — see TASK_WAZUH_OPS.md §7.2.
